title: Setup: the built-in permission set `storage_attachment_member` ("Attachments: read and attach (every member)") has no zh-CN label
body:
Filing class: ① user-visible defect (untranslated label) — reach: public door, measured in a browser. **Reader:** `domain:server` lane — whichever package declares the `storage_attachment_member` permission set (the attachment opt-in work of 18.4.0) and its zh-CN bundle.

## Symptom

Setup → 权限集分配 in a zh-CN Console lists every built-in permission set in Chinese (查看者 — 只读, 成员 — 标准访问, 组织管理员 …) except one: **`Attachments: read and attach (every member)`** (`storage_attachment_member`), which renders in English.

Measured on 18.5.0 (npm), objectstack-ai/hotclm `pnpm demo:zh`, dev admin, Console language zh-CN, `/_console/apps/com.objectstack.setup/component/security/permission-set-assignment`. Screenshot `31-setup-permission-sets.png` in the hotclm 18.5 upgrade report.

## Expected

The set's label (and description, if any) ships a zh-CN translation like its siblings; the platform's i18n coverage gate counts it.

## Business reason

An administrator assigning access reads one English row among Chinese ones; it is the set every member holds for attachments, so it is one an admin is likely to open.

Dedupe: objectstack issues (all states) for `storage_attachment_member` — 13 hits, all QA runs / attachment-access cards, none about its label.

---
_Filed from the hotclm 18.5.0 upgrade browser regression (2026-11-15)._
